name: Holiday Robotics FRIDAY
summary: A Korean wheeled industrial humanoid (176 cm, 125 kg, 64 DoF) with two 20-DoF tactile hands, built for repetitive, physically demanding work in manufacturing. Pre-order inquiries are open for research institutions, with shipping planned for the first half of 2027.

germany.statusNote: The maker takes pre-order inquiries for a research version, with priority supply in Korea and shipping from the first half of 2027. No German or EU sales route was found.
germany.leadTime: Shipping begins in the first half of 2027 (maker)

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: maximum; not split into arm payload or carried load

specs.label: DOF per hand
specs.conditions: integrated tactile sensors, 250 Hz, 0.05 N sensitivity
specs.quote: An ultra-lightweight robotic hand with 20 degrees of freedom and fully integrated tactile sensors

notes: The maker photo shows a wheeled base under a folding leg-like column, two arms and five-finger hands.
The 20 kg payload is not split into arm payload or carried load, so it is not used as a payload figure here.
Maker newsroom (15 Oct 2026) reports a humanoid factory in Seongsu, Seoul, planned for 100 units a year.

images.alt: Holiday Robotics FRIDAY wheeled humanoid, front view

evidence.task: Repetitive, physically demanding work and reusable manipulation skills in manufacturing environments
evidence.note: Maker statement; a FRIDAY demonstration at a KDB NextRound event (Aug 2026) is listed in the maker newsroom. No construction use reported.

sources.title: Holiday Robotics home page (FRIDAY for Research pre-order notice)

openQuestions: Price of the FRIDAY research version and whether it will be offered in the EU.
Per-arm payload and how the 20 kg maximum payload is defined.
Whether the wheeled base can handle ramps or uneven floors.
